name: Rikugou Ryuuji
source:
"Even if I'm being forceful in taking you with me now, even though I have no money or power, will you come with me?"

A merchant who comes to Takamagahara to peddle his wares.
An honest and serious youth who is adored by everyone.
He's working hard to obtain his own shop for the sake of a certain dream.
